name: Competitions.archi
accessBasis: Publisher-advertised RSS; linked titles and factual metadata only. No article text, images or blanket reuse grant.
coverage: Latest publisher feed entries; not the full archive.

name: EU TED
query: (classification-cpv=71400000 OR classification-cpv=71410000 OR classification-cpv=71420000) SORT BY publication-date DESC
accessBasis: Official documented keyless public Search API, with attribution.
coverage: Latest 100 ACTIVE-scope urban-planning and landscape CPV matches, including secondary codes. ACTIVE scope does not establish participation eligibility or that every notice is a new call.

name: ASLA
accessBasis: Public-page metadata collection restored at user request. Reuse permission remains unverified. No descriptions or images retained.
coverage: Public ASLA opportunity listings; deadlines and eligibility require organizer review.

name: Landezine
accessBasis: Metadata-only public listing-page collection restored at user request. Current robots permits this page; disallowed RSS paths are not requested. Reuse permission remains unverified.
coverage: Public Calls & Opportunities listing page; article publication dates are not deadlines. No descriptions or images retained.

name: Young Architects Competitions (YAC)
accessBasis: Public listing and terms reviewed. No explicit automated-access prohibition found in published participation terms; no blanket reuse license inferred. Titles, links and factual metadata only; runtime robots checks enforced.
coverage: Official open-competitions index, plus submission-calendar checks for up to 10 briefs per run. Registration dates and results dates are not submission deadlines; eligibility remains unverified.

name: Archinect
accessBasis: Official Atom feed; Archinect Terms of Use expressly exempt RSS access from the automated-access restriction. Metadata only; no article or directory scraping.
coverage: Conservatively filtered individual competition announcements from the latest 30 general-feed entries. Excludes results, shortlists and multi-competition roundups. Limited discovery, not a complete directory; deadlines and participation remain unverified.

name: ArchDaily
accessBasis: Browser-rendered public listing collection enabled at user request. Published terms require written scraping permission; publisher permission remains unresolved. Runtime robots checks enforced; no sign-in, proxies or challenge-solving.
coverage: One rendered competition index page per run; duplicate cards and result announcements excluded. Titles and links only, without descriptions/images. No detail-page crawl, pagination, inferred deadlines or open/eligibility claims.

name: Non Architecture (Non-A)
accessBasis: Browser-rendered public Open tab collection enabled at user request. Terms restrict automated access; publisher permission remains unresolved. Runtime robots checks enforced; no sign-in, proxies or challenge-solving.
coverage: One competition index page per run, scoped to the explicitly labeled Open tab. Past/results tabs excluded. An explicit coming-soon message is a successful zero-listing check. Titles and organizer links only; deadlines, fees and eligibility remain unverified.

name: Institute of Architects Bangladesh (IAB)
accessBasis: Publisher-advertised competition-category RSS; linked-title metadata only. Copyright terms reviewed; reuse permission remains unverified. Runtime robots enforced.
coverage: Latest category feed, restricted to architectural design competitions explicitly located in Bangladesh/Dhaka. Excludes congress papers, jobs and results. Older announcements may remain; no current participation, deadline or foreign-team eligibility inferred.

name: GeBIZ — Singapore design consultancy
accessBasis: Public search browser collection enabled at user request. GeBIZ notices restrict reuse outside bid preparation; publisher permission remains unresolved. Runtime robots enforced; no sign-in, proxy or challenge solving.
coverage: First public result page for each of three title searches: landscape, consultancy, urban design. Retains design/planning consultancy themes; filters routine maintenance and confirmed past closing dates. Bounded discovery, not all Singapore procurement; eligibility and shortlist requirements need notice review.
